summary: Comprehensive frontend-only test of LucidFlex $50K Battle Pass (static HTML at /lucidflex.html). All requested scenarios verified via direct DOM/JS invocation and Playwright. Rule engine (replay/enforceRules/archiveRun/confirmDeleteRun), calculator, log-trade modal, dictionary, banners, mobile layout and dark neon theme all behave per spec. Minor issues: one leftover emoji ('↔️') in Bid-Ask Spread dictionary term, an unknown Lucide icon name ('ruler-dimension-line') producing many console warnings, and a malformed element id ('dashTargetSub text' contains a space).

ui_bugs.issue: Still uses emoji '↔️' as icon instead of a Lucide <i data-lucide="..."> element. Spec requires no emoji characters visible.

Icon name not present in the Lucide icon set used by the CDN; console emits ~200 warnings and those icons never render. Use a valid name (e.g. 'ruler', 'ruler-dimension' does not exist; try 'ruler' or 'square-dashed').

Element id contains a space: id="dashTargetSub text". getElementById('dashTargetSub text') (lines 1509 & 1513) technically works but is invalid HTML and easily breaks. Rename to a valid id like 'dashTargetSubText'.
Uses cdn.tailwindcss.com in production (console warning). Not a functional bug but flagged by Tailwind for prod use.

action_items: Replace '↔️' icon in Bid-Ask Spread dictionary entry (line 1121) with a Lucide icon (e.g. arrow-left-right).
Replace all 'ruler-dimension-line' Lucide icon references with a valid Lucide name to remove console warnings and render the icon.
Fix invalid HTML id 'dashTargetSub text' -> 'dashTargetSubText' (line 271 and both getElementById calls at 1509/1513).
critical_code_review_comments: File is 2056 lines in a single HTML file - consider splitting JS into modules or at least separating rule engine, UI render, and calculator.
IDs with whitespace ('dashTargetSub text') are invalid per HTML spec; a linter/CI check would catch this.
Rule engine `replay()` is nicely deterministic; consider adding unit tests exposed on window for future automated regression.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Tests cleared localStorage key 'lucidflex_battlepass_v1' before each scenario and injected temporary state via appState / helpers in the page context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 requested scenarios were exercised. Verified results: (1) direct URL loads with dark neon theme, 81 Lucide SVGs, only one visible emoji ('↔️' in Bid-Ask term). (2) Calculator #calcSymbol has exactly [MGC, SIL, MCL]; MGC labels: cap='40 Micros or 400 XAUUSD units / 4 Minis or 400 XAUUSD units', micros='Micros or N XAUUSD units', minis='Or max N Minis or N XAUUSD units', rpm='Risk Per 1 Micro Contract (10 XAUUSD units):'. SIL/MCL mirror these with XAGUSD/USOIL/XTIUSD respectively. (3) Conversion table (data-testid=conversion-table) rows exactly match spec: Gold 10 oz / 200 XAUUSD units / 400 units; Silver 1,000 oz / 20,000 XAGUSD units / 40,000 units; Crude Oil 100 barrels / 2,000 USOIL/XTIUSD units / 4,000 units. (4) openLogTradeModal() shows 3 symbols with a Micros/Minis unit select and #tradeSizeHint text like '20 micros = 2 minis ≈ 200 XAUUSD units (200 oz) Stage cap on this date: 40 micros / 4 minis (40 micros ≈ 400 XAUUSD units)'; over-cap (4.1 minis=41 micros) shows OVER CAP warning. (5) Position overrun: 41 micros -> breached with reason 'Position size overrun (41 micros vs 40-micro Evaluation cap)'; 40 micros with +100 -> NOT breached, balance 50100. (6) DLL OFF: -1200 -> NOT breached, balance 48800; -2000 -> breached with 'EOD trailing drawdown breached (balance $48,000.00 hit floor $48,000.00)'. (7) Consistency: +3100 single trade -> breached with 'Consistency rule violated (best day 100.0% of profit at target, max 50%)'. (8) Backdated -2100 the day before +500 -> breached with EOD reason on replay. (9) confirmDeleteRun with 3 archived runs deleting #2 -> renumbered [1(47000), 2(47500), 3(47900)], activeRun.runNum=4, toast shows 'Run #2 deleted. Runs renumbered, you are now on Run #4.' openDeleteRunModal(1) shows title 'Delete Run #1?' and body 'Delete Run #1? This revokes 1 badge and removes it from lifetime stats. Cannot be undone.' (10) Reset banner: 2 .reset-banner elements visible initially; dismissBanner() hides both, sessionStorage flag set. (11) Dictionary: 28 terms, no duplicates ('Tick' and 'Risk-to-Reward' appear once each), categories include Order Types / Contracts / Analysis / Market Structure. (12) Mobile 430px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==430). Remaining issues are the three items listed under frontend_issues.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - no critical bugs. Minor icon regression: one Lucide replacement was missed for the Bid-Ask term (still '↔️'). 'ruler-dimension-line' is not a valid Lucide icon name and silently fails to render. 'dashTargetSub text' id has a stray space likely from a search/replace typo.
